description: Source code for Plotly configuration and hotkeys management in a React frontend component, including functions for toggling plot mode bar visibility, configuring plot options, and handling keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: hideModebar
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the Plotly mode bar by manipulating DOM elements and styles.

methods.name: PlotConfig
methods.description: Returns a configuration object for Plotly plots, including mode bar buttons and their click handlers.

methods.name: ChartHotkeys
methods.description: Sets up keyboard shortcuts for plot interactions, such as opening dialogs, toggling mode bar, and changing axis scales.
